content.text: About Shen YunThe ArtistsArtists in the SpotlightMeet Principal Dancer Angelia WangPrincipal Dancer Angelia Wang discusses traditional values and the humbling power of the team.ExclusiveStars of Shen Yun: Melody QinEver since she was a little girl, dance has been integral to Melody Qin’s life. Along the way, there have been both smiles and tears. The strenuous training she has undergone has not only conditioned her body but also shaped her character.Stars of Shen Yun: Piotr HuangPiotr Huang’s dance teacher once told him: “At its highest realm, classical Chinese dance is not about movement. It’s about culture.”Stars of Shen Yun: Roy Chen“Well-developed limbs and underdeveloped brains…” Is this the stigma for dancers? That’s what Roy Chen used to think before he became a dancer. But dance, he soon discovered, entails so much more.Stories of PersecutionPersecuted Artists - Pipa Virtuoso Liang YuBehind their dazzling performances, each Shen Yun artist has his or her own story. This is the story of pipa virtuoso Liang Yu.ExclusivePersecuted Artists - Jiheng ZhaoIn 2007, Jiheng Zhao made a dangerous journey from Northeastern China to the United States, hoping to escape persecution in his homeland. Persecuted Artists - Principal Dancer Steven WangWhen you watch Shen Yun’s principal dancer Steven Wang on stage—performing in the role of a mighty general or a brilliant strategist, it is hard to imagine the young child left at home with his parents both jailed.ReviewsIn the MediaMusicBehind the Scenes
